name: Tape Measure
instruction: Create a 3D model of a tape measure.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a tape measure.
The tape measure has a rectangular body.
The tape extends from a spool.
Color representation: The body of the tape measure is typically yellow.
The measuring tape is marked with black measurements.
Size: The tape length should be at least 5 meters.
Proportion: The width of the tape should be consistent with standard tape measures.
The spool should be adequately sized to hold the tape.
Texture and surface detail: The body may have a smooth plastic texture.
The tape should have a matte finish for visibility.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The tape should extend outward from the spool.
The tape should retract smoothly back into the body.
The hook at the end of the tape should be visible and functional.
Object distance and contact: The tape should not overlap with the body when retracted.
The hook should connect securely to the edge of the tape.

Instruction execution accuracy: The tape measure is accurately represented as per the instruction.
All specified attributes of a tape measure are included.
